content:
Jules (Growth): Quick sync for EchoLaunch social push next week. Short arc: X tease -> X case snippet -> LinkedIn carousel. Seed DMs to warm accounts only. Targets: 220 signups, 25 enterprise MQLs.

Tara (Content): I'll draft 2 X openers + a 3-slide LinkedIn carousel. Need hero PNG (1200x628) + small latency GIF. Can deliver copy if assets are in drive by 4pm.

Mark (Demand): Pulling warm list now (~780 contacts). We'll tag leads "echolaunch_web" and create seeded shortlinks per variant. A/B test headlines: "Predictable inference latency" vs "Lower inference spend, same quality".

Eli (Ops): Proposed schedule (PT): X tease Tue 09:30, X case Wed 10:00, LinkedIn Wed 10:10. Seed DMs 30-60m after posts to top-priority accounts. I'll prepare CSV for scheduler import and set a 20-min DM buffer.

Jules (Growth): DMs only for engagement score >70 and enterprise flag. Keep registration minimal (email). UTMs: utm_campaign=echolaunch&utm_source={channel}&utm_medium=social&utm_content={variant}.

Tara (Content): Draft copy samples:
- "See the real tradeoffs we measured in production inference. Live demo + numbers."
- "Config tweaks that cut token cost with no quality loss. Join our walkthrough."

Mark (Demand): Shortlinks ready: https://rwd.ai/echoA and https://rwd.ai/echoB. I'll queue warm-list email 10m after the first X post. SDRs: confirm capacity for 250 signups? @SDR Team

SDR Team: We can absorb ~200 immediate follow-ups. If >200, prioritize enterprise and highest intent. Auto-assign seniors to enterprise accounts.

Eli (Ops): Scheduler CSV sample row:
"platform,iso_time,variant,asset,link,utm"
"X,2026-07-07T16:30:00Z,teaseA,hero_echo_v1.png,https://rwd.ai/echoA,utm_campaign=echolaunch&utm_content=teaseA"

Tara (Content): Upload folder: https://drive.redwood/marketing/echolaunch-drafts. I'll add alt text and accessibility notes.

Jules (Growth): EOD checklist: Tara upload assets, Mark seed links + email queue, Eli import schedule + DM flow, SDR Team share prioritization doc. Quick 10-min pre-launch call tomorrow 09:00 PT.

SchedulerBot: Drafts saved to scheduler; approval reminder set for 17:30 PT. Campaign tags applied: campaign=echolaunch, channel=social.

Mark (Demand): Warm list export done; shortlinks live.

Tara (Content): Assets uploaded in 35m.

SDR Team: Prioritization doc shared: https://docs.redwood/sdr/echolaunch-priority.

Jules (Growth): Thanks everyone 525 ping this thread for blockers.
